subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] P10 crypto-fear-channel 升 REVIEW STAGE (4.40★ + research-honesty hotfix; portfolio 第三篇)
body:
Alert level: info
Title: P10 crypto-fear-channel 升 REVIEW STAGE (4.40★ + research-honesty hotfix; portfolio 第三篇)

## 觸發條件

P10 (crypto-fear-channel) 從 draft → **review stage** 達標 (commit 78593750)。

v2 paper-review-cycle round (2026-04-28):
- **Academic**: 0 CRITICAL / 0 SEVERE / 0 MAJOR / 3 MED / 5 MINOR — **4.40★/5** (v1 3.95 → v2 4.40, +0.45★)
- **Citation**: 0 MAJOR / 1 MED / 5 MINOR (v1 1/5/7 across all tiers improved)
- 19/25 v1 issues verified closed via v2.1 (commit 13638cd2) + v2.2 (commit 8a68fdc5) batch fix
- **v2.3 same-day hotfix** 3 issues: 1 research-honesty fix + 2 cosmetic

reviews 歸檔 paper/crypto-fear-channel/review_history/{v1,v2}/{academic,citation}_review_report.md + README.md

## 影響

直接服務 Mission 第 3 條（top-tier journal 投稿）。P10 為 9-paper portfolio **第三篇 review-or-higher stage**（前兩篇 P5 vt-crowding-abm + P6 prg-periodic-garch 已 ready_for_submission）。Body draft 5 slot 完成 + review-cycle 2 round 收斂 = 自主推進 effort 約 8 slot。

## 6/6 Stage Gate

| # | Criterion | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | latex >=4★ | ✅ 4.40★ |
| 2 | citation 0 MAJOR + <=3 MED | ✅ 0/1 MED |
| 3 | reproduce GREEN | ✅ 29/29 100% |
| 4 | compile clean | ✅ 16p, 0 errors |
| 5 | self-contained replication | ✅ data + reproduce.py + snapshot |

## Process Discipline Lesson Logged

**v2 process 引入 NEW MED-1 因 SEV-3 fix 寫了 JSON 無 backing 的 γ rolling-window quantitative claims** (median t<1.5, half-positive sign — 全部 fabricated)。立即 hotfix 軟化為 qualitative footnote 承認 rolling-γ diagnostics 留 follow-up。

**Lesson**: quantitative claims must have JSON backing before prose written, 否則 stay qualitative or trigger experiment re-run。Supplements paper-workflow.md hard rule 3 (table-row-to-JSON binding) with body-prose parallel rule。

主線程立即 catch + hotfix 是 self-correcting research-honesty 機制 working as intended。待 docs/error_log.md 下次 routine 補完整 lesson entry。

## 建議行動

無 user action 需。下個階段 (continuous review loop):
1. **Cross-paper meta-evaluation** (NotebookLM-style 跨 paper 審查) — 對照 P5/P6/P9 portfolio 確認 P10 contribution 不重疊
2. **1-2 monthly cycle** (v3 預計 2026-05-28) → 升 ready_for_submission stage
3. **Optional**: rolling-γ extension experiment 補 §7 quantitative diagnostics（解 v2 NEW MED-1 完整 fix vs current honest qualitative defer）

Predicted outcomes (post-v2.3):
- JIMFIM R&R/accept ~85-90%
- JEF backup ~80%
- FRL backup ~85% (loses §8.2 reconciliation strength via shorter format)

Cumulative P10 progress 2026-04-28 single-day: 5 increments body draft (4,887 words) + reproduce 7→29 + main.tex canonical + v1 round + 2-batch fix + v2 round + hotfix → **review stage**。
